coverage.scope_definition: Original brief O1-O6 and exactly the seven named PlanUnits plus all three copied context files. P01-P43 are grouped frozen owner decisions, not added requirements or exhaustive opportunities. Assessment completion is separate from candidate satisfaction.
coverage.count_convention: complete is the number of enumerated assessment items in that category; assessed means semantically reviewed, not passed. Categories overlap and must not be summed. Primary scope = 6 brief obligations + 10 frozen owner records.

axes.name: Original obligations and all frozen decisions
Consequential claims, governing context and versions
Bounded discovery, mechanisms, alternatives, negative/opportunity coverage
Proposed versus executed validation and witness applicability

brief_obligations.limit: Useful bounded discovery; no exhaustive recall or independently verified discovery chronology.
Immutable implementation/definition/caller inspected. No runtime claim.
Substantive admitted critic and dispositions checked; actual flash-family/provider/lifecycle provenance excluded from source judgment.

critic_dispositions.name: Zed analogy is not PM defect

review_limits: No exhaustive opportunity recall. Optional unresearched approaches are not counted as unassessed required rows.
No app build/test/benchmark or downloaded-code execution; candidate historical execution logs unavailable.
No latest/current-release sweep or proof of every supported renderer/OS.
Visible control paths and topic/procedure structure weaken blinding; source-map timing/native Goal/counters were ignored.
blinding_limits: Arm name visible in admitted paths.
Two-topic authored structure and procedure prose can reveal method.
Source maps contain author timing/counters/native Goal/provenance fields; ignored for source judgment.
